evidence.why: Shows state-0 entry, falling physics, landing, and support-loss re-entry.
Carrier release uses this entry before clearing its Food reference.

facts.rationale: The helper selects Food state 0, whose physics performs falling and whose collision handles landing. It is used after spawn initialization, after support loss, and on carrier release. EnterFalling replaces the unresolved numeric motion label with its supported role and complements the existing EnterResting name; this is a semantic inference, not a recovered original symbol.
